description: Go to an address (IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md §1.3, D-048): the NJOGIS statewide geocoding service, asked for candidates with findAddressCandidates. When it finds nothing, the slower fallback searches NJOGIS address points by house number and street name, the indexed fields (a text search of the full address took over 40 s).
attribution: Address search: New Jersey Office of GIS (NJOGIS)
